subject: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Oct 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot

Hi team — looping you all on a tight pilot that Nimbus needs aligned by early November. Two asks up front:

1) Can we land a stripped-down enablement timeline (training, doc handoff, CS runbook) they can sign off on by EOD Friday? I attached a quick chronograph to start.
2) Nimbus asked for a formal exception template for feature gating (their legal wants a documented fallback cadence). I sketched a template — can Product/Legal-ish PMs make it actionable?

Key constraints:
- Pilot start target: 2028-11-06 (customer hard date)
- Canary window: 1 week, then gradual ramp to 10% traffic
- Need on-call CS coverage for first 72 hours after canary launch

Alice — can you confirm the procurement/contracting dates so we can align rollout?

Attachments: enablement_chronograph_v1.xlsx, exception_request_template.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Customer Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Oct 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot

Vanessa — thanks for the clear asks. Quick notes from infra/serving side:

- Dedicated capacity team can reserve the GPU pool for the canary week but we need a committed window by Friday to avoid conflicts with another reserved job (we have a pre-committed run 11/02–11/04).
- Feature gating: we can ship a simple toggle + fallback to last-stable model. The exception template should include the exact rollback TL (which infra needs) and the observability signal thresholds.

I'll take the enablement chronograph and map it to oncall + infra handoffs; Laura — can you own the documentation owner list and the doc upload to Drive?

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager | Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Oct 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot

Following up with owners + doc plan. Per Marcus — I created a single sheet with owners and upload targets. High-level:

- Product runbook (owner: Aditya Rao) — includes feature flag semantics and rollback playbook
- Customer-facing quick start (owner: Laura Bennett) — 1 doc, <3 pages, copied to Nimbus-facing Drive folder
- CS runbook and escalation ladder (owner: Priyom Das) — include contact matrix and expected SLAs for canary phase

I'll upload the drives and add permissions by EOD today. Vanessa — do you want the customer quick start to be co-branded? If yes, we need brand approval (takes ~48 hours).

Attachments: pilot-canary-window.csv

Laura
Platform PM | Redwood Console
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Oct 2028 12:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot

Flagging a small product ask — Nimbus wants an API knob to reduce hallucination risk on a high-precision flow (they'll feed structured prompts). We can provide a model variant recommendation (lower-temp + calibrated top-p) and a simple request header to force the variant. Timeline: we can have the variant available as a documented model alias by 11/03 if infra confirms capacity.

Proposed adjusted rollout:
- 11/06: internal canary (0% external traffic, internal validation)
- 11/07–11/13: external canary (1% → 10% traffic)
- 11/14: ramp decision meeting (go/no-go)

Need: Marcus — final confirmation on reserved pool & fallback SLAs. Priyom — confirm CS rota for 11/06–11/17. Vanessa — do we want to ask Nimbus for a business continuity contact (legal/procurement) in case the exception authorization needs signoff?

Aditya
Product Manager | Inference Features
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Alice Morgan <alice@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Enablement chronograph & exception template for Nimbus pilot

All — final check from CS/ops side:

- CS rota confirmed: Priyom (lead), +2 from CS for first 72 hours (11/06–11/09), escalation to Marcus for infra incidents.
- I updated the exception_request_template.docx with the SLAs, rollback windows, and signoff flow. Vanessa — please review before I send to Alice and procurement.
- Procurement note: Alice, if Nimbus can confirm SOW and payment terms by 10/30 we can keep the 11/06 target. If procurement slides, we need the fallback plan below.

Fallback plan (if procurement delays):
- Move external canary by one week (start 11/14), keep internal validation on 11/06
- Or provide a limited beta (read-only) integration while contracts finalize

Vanessa — give the go and I will send the updated template to Nimbus + link the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3enablement).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
